1263-4871-5670-5708.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
1263-4871-5670-5708.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Vein Ripper and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

Activate Evereth by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

When the basic land enters, Lotus Cobra and Thranduil's Company trigger.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Thranduil's Company trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

When the Servo enters, Arcbound Crusher triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 3.

Cast Traveling Plague by paying {3}{B}{B}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Traveling Plague enters, Chishiro triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature Traveling Plague is attached to.
When the creature dies, Traveling Plague triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token created in step 2.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 once.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 4

Cast Nature's Rhythm from your hand by paying {5}{G}{G} or from your graveyard for its harmonize cost by paying at most {5}{G}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Karmic Guide and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning an applicable target from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Karmic Guide that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Karmic Guide token enters, it triggers, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

Earthbend a basic land you control.
Cast Legolas's Quick Reflexes by paying {G}, targeting the earthbent land.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the earthbent land, targeting the earthbent land.
The land triggers, causing it to deal damage equal to its power to Screaming Nemesis.
Screaming Nemesis triggers, dealing that much damage to an applicable target.
Resolve the Earthcraft trigger, untapping the earthbent land.
Repeat from step 3.
149-2757-5759--143.notes: The {G} in the mana cost can be waived if you earthbend a Forest and tap it for mana before casting Legolas's Quick Reflexes. You may need additional mana to earthbend the land depending on the method of earthbending used.

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Spirit, adding {1}.

Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.

Repeat.

Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the All-Fates Stalker token.

Resolve the Phantom Train ability.

Activate Darksteel Citadel by tapping it, adding {C}.

Ancient Den enters the battlefield, triggering Retreat to Coralhelm, untapping Goblin Welder.
Activate Ancient Den by tapping it, adding {W}.

Cast Serra Avatar by paying {4}{W}{W}{W}.
Serra Avatar enters the battlefield, triggering Angelic Chorus, causing you to gain life equal to Serra Avatar's toughness.
Sanguine Bond triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the life you gained.
Each opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

Play the land from your graveyard.
